difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the global sections functor and the section functors over objects commute with derived limits, and produces the associated short exact sequences relating the cohomology of a derived limit to the derived limit of the cohomologies (statement lines 5125-5138). The proof identifies the section functors with derived pushforwards to the point topos and applies the companion result on commutation of derived pushforwards with derived limits (proof lines 5140-5143), and then reads the short exact sequences off the defining triangle of the derived limit (proof lines 5143-5147). The non-formal content is the identification of the section functors as pushforwards. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one exact-sequence computation.
